tools.name: billing_list-seats
tools.description: Billable users for each account on the new Hook platform the key covers, for one calendar month, counted only from Hook's own records. An account created on the new platform bills the highest daily count of active people on a day it was active, the rule Hook's monthly usage report uses. An account that moved there from the legacy platform has no daily count yet: it bills the people in Hook's records at any point in the month, including anyone removed during it, who are not set inactive today. It is listed from the month its first simulation on the new platform started or its first training there was assigned, when it has such people and is not still suspended from before the month. Its rows are recomputed from today's records, so store the figures you invoice from. created_on_new_platform says which rule applies. Both start in October 2026; earlier months have no recorded counts. Which accounts are on the new platform is decided by their state today. Organizations still on the legacy platform are not listed. A client deleted during or after the month is still listed for it (organization_state deleted). Clients are grouped by today's organization tree: a client moved to another MSP is listed under its current MSP only. Without month, the current month so far; a cursor belongs to its month and filters. An MSP's own staff are free NFR seats from December 2026, up to 100 people: nfr_users says how many of an MSP row's billable_users that covers. Optional: month, organization_id, parent_id (plus 2 more). Returns array of BillingSeats.
